texts: What do you want to install?
Put the unit in download mode
Crestron's debug Android. The Crestron firmware stays on the unit as the backup.
Linux in place of the Crestron firmware. All settings and data on the unit are erased.
Before you start, do these steps. The installer cannot do them for you.
On the unit's Crestron web page:
Auto update is off (Settings, Auto Update).
XiO Cloud connection is off (XiO Cloud).
Optional: the update server URL is changed to an address that does not answer.
Optional: the internet is blocked for this unit.
The unit's power (PoE) stays on during the whole install.
A USB-C cable connects the unit to this computer.
Keep a copy of the Crestron userdebug firmware file (pcdfw-1.0.0.94-userdebug.bin) on this computer. The next step shows where to get it.
This computer has about 2.5 GB of free disk space for the download.
Zadig is on this computer (zadig.akeo.ie). The page tells you when to use it.
The page downloads what it needs. You can go on while it downloads.
Use a folder on this computer
Crestron may remove this link at any time. Keep a copy of the file.
Using the folder uc-pxx-mainline from this computer: OK
With a key you can log in to the new system as root over your network. Paste the one line of your .pub file. Never paste a private key.
1. Connect the unit's USB-C port to this computer.
2. Power on the unit. The LED cycles red, green, blue, white, then after a few seconds blinks green.

3. When the LED blinks green, press and hold Vol− and Mic Mute (the Mic key, not the speaker key). The unit restarts: the LED cycles the colours again, then the screen stays on the Crestron logo. That logo screen is download mode.
4. Press "Connect to the unit" and choose the unit in the list.
Windows: the first time on this computer
Windows needs a USB driver for the unit in this step, once per computer.
1. Leave the unit as it is now.
3. In Zadig, choose Options, then List All Devices.
4. In the list, choose the device with USB ID 2207 330C.
5. Choose WinUSB as the driver, then press Install Driver (or Replace Driver).
6. When Zadig says that the driver is installed, press Connect to the unit again.
The unit restarts. Keep it connected.
Working. Do not unplug the unit and do not close this page.
Press Connect and choose the unit again.
4. In the list, choose the device with USB ID 18D1 D00D.
6. When Zadig says that the driver is installed, press Connect again.
The unit reads the firmware file.
The unit shows the install plan. Hold OK (the Mic key) for 3 seconds to start the install.
Installing. Do not disconnect the power.
Step 2 starts on the unit by itself. To stop it, press Back on the unit.
Step 2 runs on the unit. Do not disconnect the power.
Done. Mainline Linux is installed. You can disconnect the cable.
Keep them if you install another unit.
